text:
maya: quick notes from today's lightweight speculative handoff test on new 13B quant candidate. sharing numbers + next-step plan.

lin: handoff = speculative small-model prefix then confirm with big model?

maya: correct. run a 3B-quant to generate tokens 1..L and stream them as provisional; confirm/continue with 13B-quant. intent is lower TTFB for short replies.

otto: what thresholds for accepting provisional tokens?

maya: acceptance rules: top1_prob > 0.6 and top1_gap > 0.22; per-token sym-kl to main < 0.14. if any token fails we abort provisional stream and regen from that token. cap regens at 1 for latency reasons.

perf-bot: dev bench (V100):
```
cheap p50/token 11ms
main p50/token 26ms
L=5 -> client-first-byte p50 ~62ms vs baseline ~170ms
short-prompt p95 end2end -28%
```

lin: automatically measured quality?

maya: small holdout 350 samples: EM-like drop 0.9%, embed-cosine -0.011. human AB (50 pairs): provisional favored 24%, baseline 58%, tie 18%. extraction tasks worst.

otto: mitigation ideas?

maya: tried two knobs: tighter conf gate (0.7) and token-class filter (only allow filler/stopwords). tight gate reduces pref hit but keeps gains; token filter preserves quality but kills most latency wins.

lin: cost note? running both models in parallel affects infra.

maya: short sessions see net token-cost down ~15% because many answers terminate within L. long sessions worse. plan: per-route opt-in and metricized rollout.

otto: proposed eval/playbook?

maya: 1) 5k stratified holdout (QA, extract, summarize, chat, code) with 1k adversarial token-split cases. 2) run configs: aggressive(L=8, low conf), balanced(L=5, conf 0.6), conservative(L=3, conf 0.75), token-filter(L=6). 3) capture BLEU/ROUGE/EM, embed sim, regen rate, token-symkl hist, latency p50/p95, cost/session. 4) N=500 human judgements for priority classes. 5) prod canary: 1% traffic, auto-roll back if regen_rate>10% or human-pref proxy drop >5% for 24h.

lin: runtime work: add prefill flag to API, ephemeral logits cache, provisional-stream bit in responses, trace spans prefill/confirm. Console needs prefills_attempted/streamed/confirmed/regens.

maya: will push configs + adversarial set to branch tonight and kick off expanded runs. will ping here when results land.

otto: SGTM. schedule 30-min followup after expanded run results. :calendar:
